title: Glowing robot vacuum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Floor shadow/glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='36' ry='9' fill='#1a3a4a'/>
  <!-- Main body top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='34' ry='20' fill='#2e5d7a'/>
  <!-- Main body side -->
  <path d='M16 52 Q16 74 50 74 Q84 74 84 52 Z' fill='#1f4a63'/>
  <!-- Body highlight rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='34' ry='20' fill='none' stroke='#5fa8c9' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Bumper strip -->
  <path d='M18 60 Q18 71 50 71 Q82 71 82 60' fill='none' stroke='#6fd8f0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Top panel -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='22' ry='12' fill='#3d7a99'/>
  <!-- Glowing LED ring display -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='15' ry='8' fill='#0d2a38'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='15' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#7ff2ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Glowing smile face on top -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='48' r='2.2' fill='#9ffcff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='48' r='2.2' fill='#9ffcff'/>
  <path d='M44 53 Q50 57 56 53' fill='none' stroke='#9ffcff' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Glowing dots around ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='41.5' r='1.2' fill='#5fe0ff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='1.2' fill='#5fe0ff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='54' r='1.2' fill='#5fe0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58.5' r='1.2' fill='#5fe0ff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='54' r='1.2' fill='#5fe0ff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='1.2' fill='#5fe0ff'/>
  <!-- Side brush left -->
  <ellipse cx='13' cy='66' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#6fd8f0'/>
  <rect x='11' y='62' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
  <!-- Side brush right -->
  <ellipse cx='87' cy='66' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#6fd8f0'/>
  <rect x='86' y='62' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
  <!-- Front bumper light glows -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='67' r='2' fill='#b6f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='67' r='2' fill='#b6f7ff'/>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='74' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#0f2e3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='74' rx='3' ry='1.6' fill='#4fc3e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='74' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#0f2e3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='74' rx='3' ry='1.6' fill='#4fc3e0'/>
  <!-- Under-glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='22' ry='3' fill='#2a6e8a' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
